description: Source file implementing Windows Audio API (WASAPI) audio device initialization and management for UWP platform, including device change handling, format support, and passthrough configuration.

classes.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams
classes.description: Manages cached parameters for default audio renderer, updates on device change, provides support info for passthrough codecs.

classes.name: WASAPIAudioDevice
classes.description: Handles initialization and activation of WASAPI audio device, including format setup and device change handling.

methods.name: SetPassthroughWaveformat
methods.description: Configures WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE structure for passthrough audio formats (AC3/EAC3).

methods.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams::GetBitrate
methods.description: Returns cached bitrate of default audio renderer.

methods.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams::GetNumChannels
methods.description: Returns cached number of channels of default audio renderer.

methods.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams::GetPassthroughCodecSupport
methods.description: Checks support for specified passthrough codec (AC3/EAC3).

methods.name: WASAPIAudioDevice::InitializeAudioDevice
methods.description: Starts asynchronous activation of the default audio device.

methods.name: WASAPIAudioDevice::ActivateCompleted
methods.description: Completes device activation, retrieves format info, and sets passthrough support flags.
